title: PRD-11 synthetic risk input syntax

travelerRefs.description: required; 1–100 authorized refs; larger groups use bulk workflow. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: TRAVELER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

destinationPlanCode.description: required; explicit offered pilgrimage destination/program <= 40. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PILGRIMAGE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

departureDate.description: required; explicit calendar/timezone context. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: DEPARTURE_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

durationDays.description: required; 1–3660 technical bound; actual max from carrier. Sensitivity: internal. Error: DURATION_NOT_OFFERED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

organizerRef.description: optional; authorized organizer relationship. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ORGANIZER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

assistancePlanCode.description: required; versioned emergency/assistance plan. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ASSISTANCE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

requiredTravelEvidenceRef.description: conditional; contract-defined evidence only. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: TRAVEL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
